bullets.text: A rashly driven MTC bus killed a 49-year-old woman on her way to a hospital near Puzhal, and the office should monitor road safety enforcement.
Two female wardens were booked for harassing a Class 11 student in Chennai and Nagercoil, and the office should follow the police investigation closely.
Two suspects in a grocery shop owner murder case were detained under the Goondas Act in Thiruttani, and the district team should monitor law and order.
Officials in Thiruttani allegedly refused to provide 125 days of work under the rural employment scheme to persons with disabilities, and the office should verify this.
Over 3,000 streetlights remain non-functional in Avadi despite a maintenance contract, and the office should press local authorities for prompt repairs.
The Tamil Nadu government allocated Rs 125 crore to roll out a scheme for AI assistive devices for persons with disabilities, and the portfolio team should track implementation.
A senior Meity official stated that the ministry is not issuing social media takedown orders, and the portfolio team should watch federal digital policy updates.
